name: Hacker News (Show HN)

rules_quotes.quote: Please don't use HN primarily for promotion.
Please submit the original source.
Please don't put generated text in HN posts.
For the same reason, please don't automate posting.

notes: Link and discussion site where a person submits a story or a Show HN post by hand; automated posting is asked against.

name: Product Hunt

rules_quotes.quote: The only real rule here is that you cannot ask people directly to upvote your product.
You can launch as often as you have new significant product iterations available.

notes: Daily product launch site where a maker posts a launch by hand from a personal account; company accounts are not allowed.

name: BetaList

rules_quotes.quote: Each startup gets up to two opportunities to be featured: once pre-launch and once at launch.

name: DevHunt

rules_quotes.quote: Links on free listings are nofollow; paid launches get a permanent dofollow link.

notes: Launch site for developer tools where a maker submits a tool by hand; free and paid launch options exist.

name: Future Tools

rules_quotes.quote: If you submitted a tool and it was not listed within a week of submission, you can resubmit it and we will review it again.

notes: AI tool directory curated by Matt Wolfe's team; a person submits a tool through a web form and it is reviewed by a human.

name: TWIML AI Community

rules_quotes.quote: The one exception to this is in the #bulletin-board channel. Feel free to post links to your content there.

name: Medium

rules_quotes.quote: Posting content primarily to drive traffic to, or increase the search rankings of, an external site, product, or service
Performing a disproportionately large number of interactions, particularly by automated means.

notes: Open publishing platform where a writer posts a story by hand in the editor; spam and automated bulk interactions are removed.

name: Substack

rules_quotes.quote: We are vehemently anti-spam and anti-phishing.

rules_quotes.quote: Posting promotional content outside of these 4 channels is not allowed
